mostWorthwhile.text: The fat combination was most worthwhile: its planned picture and explanation distinguish dispersing droplets from enzymatic breakdown, including the explicit clarification that bile is not an enzyme.

leastWorthwhile.text: The individual pancreas fitting was thin: it confirmed placement without adding picture detail or explaining the connection at that point.

surprise.text: The two-stage starch sequence made the intermediate chains visible before individual glucose molecules appeared; the enzymes' separate roles could have been clearer.

arbitrary.text: The organ fittings had a clear assembly purpose, but their immediate results gave little sense of how the organs connected or worked. The later summary helped.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see how these products cross the intestinal lining, though the repetitive fittings and brief explanations make that a qualified yes.
